notes.title: New Announcements from DOSMan Games!
notes.content:
[p]Here at DOSMan, we've been hard at work lately, and we've made multiple new game announcements!

Check them out here, and be sure to add them to your wishlists:



BIOMEAT HUSKWORLD

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620550/BIOMEAT_HUSKWORLD/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][previewyoutube="UtD0G8ItYiA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.



BLOODMATCH

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3777500/Bloodmatch/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][previewyoutube="vxxwsGXZf6A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…



NIGHT JACKAL: BLOOD DEBT

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3620560/Night_Jackal_Blood_Debt/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][previewyoutube="1s81rp8C4uU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

A masked vigilante seeks revenge, unravels a conspiracy, and teeters on the edge of sanity in this retro-inspired boomer shooter.



THE HENCHMEN

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431750/The_Henchmen/"][/dynamiclink] [/p][previewyoutube="qJM2Z8AfmIU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

The Henchmen is a pulp-inspired, 90s fueled top-down, action retro open-world game set in the fictional city of New Queens during 1990 and 1996.



Thanks for stopping by!

DOSMan Games[/p]

notes.title: Update 27th January 2025
notes.content:
Patch notes:
Fixed some levels where you can go out of map
Fixed statue room glitch
Fixed glitch in level 2 where you can go throw fire
Fixed blood in air from flying enemies
Changed visual door for blue locket key in Hell 2 level
[b]Added ultra hard secret level hidden if you choose evil path![/b]

notes.title: Update Notes 18th Jan 2025
notes.content:
intro letter shown at start 17 sec (cant be skipped but show only for one time even if player repeat 1 level)
crucifix given in hand at the start (a lot of player missed it at first)
added pistols and tommygun to more levels (pistols was only in first level)
fire candlesticks dont bleed anymore ( lol :D)
in last city level added little help where to find golden key (via statue) (next to door is scroll with help)
in Lucifer level added more blocks and floors to prevent droping glitch (not 100% but it shoudb e better)
